serverInfo.name: code-ast-mcp
serverInfo.description: A Python AST Codebase Architecture & Symbol Inspector MCP Server

tools.name: analyze_file_ast
tools.description: Parse a Python file using Python's AST parser and return a detailed outline of its docstrings, imports, top-level classes, functions, variables, and line counts.

file_path.description: Path to the Python (.py) file to analyze.

tools.name: find_class_methods
tools.description: Locate a specific class within a Python file and retrieve all its methods, argument signatures, type annotations, line numbers, and docstrings.

file_path.description: Path to the Python file containing the class.

class_name.description: Name of the target class to inspect.

tools.name: find_symbol
tools.description: Recursively search a directory or file for classes, functions, methods, or variables matching the target symbol name.

target_dir.description: Directory path or file path to search.

symbol_name.description: Name or partial name of the symbol to search for.

tools.name: get_imports_graph
tools.description: Scan all Python files in a directory to build an import dependency graph and output both a structured map and a Mermaid diagram definition.

target_dir.description: Path to the directory containing Python files.

tools.name: find_missing_docstrings
tools.description: Audit Python files in a directory to identify modules, classes, and functions that lack docstrings, calculating overall docstring coverage percentage.

include_private.description: Whether to include private functions/methods (starting with '_').

resources.name: Workspace AST Statistics
resources.description: Provide high-level AST statistics for the current workspace.

prompts.name: refactor_code_summary
prompts.description: Generate a prompt guiding the LLM to inspect the AST outline of a Python file and provide actionable code refactoring, architectural, and documentation advice.

arguments.name: file_path
arguments.description: Path to the target Python file for refactoring review.
